import json,hashlib,sys,subprocess,tempfile
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()))
from transformers import AutoTokenizer
from finetune.eval_review_deployment import build_compatible_tokenizer,_read_gguf_tokenizer_metadata
x=json.load(open('docs/results/ollama-tokenizer-reference-20261015.json')); results={}
extra=["we'ſ we'S we're WE'RE 'İ 'ı",'a\u0301 a\u0327\u0301 A\u030a \u1100\u1161','👩\u200d🔬 🏳️\u200d🌈 العربية हिन्दी','\r\n\t\u00a0\u2028\u2029 test\x00end','<|fim_prefix|><|repo_name|><|file_sep|><tool_call></tool_call>','<|audio_start|><|audio_end|><tts_pad><tts_text_bos><tts_text_eod><tts_text_bos_single><|audio_pad|>','[PAD0][PAD249][PAD248077][PAD248319]']
for name,a in x['spec']['models'].items():
 renderer=AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(a['hf_assets'],local_files_only=True,trust_remote_code=False)
 compat=build_compatible_tokenizer({'path':a['hf_assets'],'model_sha256':a['manifest']['sha256']},renderer,assets={'manifest':a['manifest'],'gguf':a['gguf']})
 metadata=_read_gguf_tokenizer_metadata(a['gguf']['path'])
 cases=[{'id':'extended-'+str(i),'raw_text':t} for i,t in enumerate(extra)]
 cases.extend({'id':'every-declared-token-'+str(i),'raw_text':s} for i,s in enumerate(metadata['tokenizer.ggml.tokens'][248044:],248044))
 with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='mvllm-compat-public-') as work:
  paths=[]
  for i,c in enumerate(cases):
   p=Path(work)/f'{i}.txt';p.write_bytes(c['raw_text'].encode());paths.append(str(p))
  command=['/usr/bin/sandbox-exec','-p','(version 1)(allow default)(deny network*)','/usr/bin/arch','-x86_64',x['spec']['helper']['path'],a['gguf']['path'],*paths]
  proc=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=60,env={'PATH':'/usr/bin:/bin','LC_ALL':'C','HOME':work})
  assert proc.returncode==0,proc.stderr[-1000:]
  assert 'vocab only - skipping tensors' in proc.stderr
  observed=[json.loads(row) for row in proc.stdout.splitlines()]
  assert len(observed)==len(cases)
  mismatch=[]
  for c,actual in zip(cases,observed):
   expected=compat.encode(c['raw_text'],add_special_tokens=False)
   c.update({'compatibility_ids':expected,'installed_x86_ids':actual,'exact_ids_match':expected==actual})
   if expected!=actual:mismatch.append(c)
  results[name]={'identity':compat.compatibility_counter_identity,'cases':cases,'mismatches':mismatch,'actual_loaded_packaged_images':[r[12:] for r in proc.stderr.splitlines() if r.startswith('AUDIT_IMAGE=')], 'stderr':proc.stderr,'command':command}
  print(name,'cases',len(cases),'mismatch',len(mismatch),str(mismatch)[:2000],flush=True)
Path('/tmp/mvllm-compatibility-expanded-observation.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
